pages.text:
Walk while you talk. Standing still is how things end up eaten.

You smell like the rift. Everyone does, the first week. It passes.

Good. Then keep up.

Here is the whole of it. You are fast. You are not fast alone. Anything you can run
down by yourself was already dying, and the rest you take with the pack at your
shoulder -- and the pack does not wait for you to finish deciding.

Change. Now, not in a moment. Animal Form is not something you put on for the hunt.
It is how you learn the ground under your own feet. Run the ring road until you stop
thinking about running it.

Until it is boring. Then further.

The sentry at the south gate logs every new mouth in this city. See her, and after
that Ennara is yours to wear out.
